records.context: Without this check, a misnamed `dependent_variable` passes the early checks and fails inside the merge, after the whole score table has been read, with a message that names the missing column but not the available ones.
records.label: spacr.columns#1
records.source: Without this check, a misnamed `dependent_variable` passes the early checks and fails inside the merge, after the whole score table has been read, with a message that names the missing column but not the available ones.
records.translation: Sin esta comprobación, un `dependent_variable` mal escrito supera las comprobaciones iniciales y falla dentro de la fusión, después de haber leído toda la tabla de puntuaciones, con un mensaje que nombra la columna ausente pero no las disponibles.

records.context: Three rules apply:
records.label: spacr.columns#2
records.source: Three rules apply:
records.translation: Se aplican tres reglas:

records.context: 1.  Only the header row is read (`nrows=0`). The check runs before the run, sometimes to populate a GUI dropdown on the main GUI execution path, and a score CSV can be hundreds of megabytes.
records.label: spacr.columns#3
records.source: 1.  Only the header row is read (`nrows=0`). The check runs before the run, sometimes to populate a GUI dropdown on the GUI thread, and a score CSV can be hundreds of megabytes.
records.translation: 1.  Solo se lee la fila de encabezado (`nrows=0`). La comprobación se ejecuta antes de la ejecución, a veces para rellenar un menú desplegable de la GUI en el hilo de la GUI, y un CSV de puntuaciones puede ocupar cientos de megabytes.

records.context: 2.  A missing file is reported separately from a missing column. A missing file has no header to compare against; a missing column is reported with the columns that do exist.
records.label: spacr.columns#4
records.source: 2.  A missing file is reported separately from a missing column. A missing file has no header to compare against; a missing column is reported with the columns that do exist.
records.translation: 2.  Un archivo ausente se informa por separado de una columna ausente. Un archivo ausente no tiene encabezado con el que comparar; una columna ausente se informa junto con las columnas que sí existen.

records.context: 3.  Suggestions are given in addition to the full column list. Near-misses are listed first because `predictions` for `prediction` is a common typo, and the full list is always included as well.
records.label: spacr.columns#5
records.source: 3.  Suggestions are given in addition to the full column list. Near-misses are listed first because `predictions` for `prediction` is a common typo, and the full list is always included as well.
records.translation: 3.  Las sugerencias se dan además de la lista completa de columnas. Las coincidencias aproximadas se listan primero porque `predictions` en lugar de `prediction` es una errata habitual, y la lista completa también se incluye siempre.

records.source: Overlaps are averaged, not overwritten. Where two tiles cover the same pixel they are two measurements of it, and taking the last one writes a visible step at every seam that a segmenter reads as an edge. When the placement is slightly off, averaging blurs the seam rather than doubling a structure.

records.context: The GPU-suitable steps of OPS are the per-window affine warp, peak finding, the unmixing matrix multiply and Cellpose segmentation (which has its own GPU path), and, for the merge, ORB detection with Hamming descriptor matching and mutual-nearest-neighbour cell matching. These reduce to three primitives: a windowed maximum, a matrix multiply and a nearest-neighbour search. They are collected here so device handling lives in one place.
records.translation: Los pasos de OPS adecuados para GPU son la deformación afín por ventana, la búsqueda de picos, la multiplicación por la matriz de desmezcla y la segmentación con Cellpose (que tiene su propia ruta de GPU) y, para la fusión, la detección ORB con emparejamiento de descriptores por distancia de Hamming y el emparejamiento de células por vecinos más cercanos mutuos. Todo ello se reduce a tres primitivas: un máximo por ventanas, una multiplicación de matrices y una búsqueda de vecinos más cercanos. Se reúnen aquí para que la gestión de dispositivos viva en un solo lugar.

The processing session completes, the numbers are plausible, and the barcodes are noise. There is no later check that can catch it, because nothing downstream knows what the per-cycle values were. So :func:`decode_input` refuses an array whose cycle axis has been collapsed, and this module offers no way to average one.

records.source: This constraint is enforced in code. A mean across cycles of a four-channel readout still looks like a four-channel readout: ``call_reads`` accepts it, returns a barcode of the right length, and every downstream table fills in. The run completes, the numbers are plausible, and the barcodes are noise. There is no later check that can catch it, because nothing downstream knows what the per-cycle values were. So :func:`decode_input` refuses an array whose cycle axis has been collapsed, and this module offers no way to average one.
records.translation: Esta restricción se aplica en el código. La ejecución termina, los números son plausibles y los códigos de barras son ruido. No existe ninguna comprobación posterior que pueda detectarlo, porque nada aguas abajo sabe cuáles eran los valores por ciclo. Por eso :func:`decode_input` rechaza una matriz cuyo eje de ciclos se ha colapsado, y este módulo no ofrece ninguna forma de promediar uno.

records.context: This checks the microplate sample position used as a length scale. A microplate sample position is circular; a box much wider than it is tall means the detector clipped it at an image edge, or merged two microplate sample positions, or found something that is not a microplate sample position. Any of those makes :attr:`diameter_px` wrong, and since that diameter rescales every area in the microplate sample position, a wrong one is worse than a missing one.
records.label: spacr.plaque.Well.axis_ratio#1
records.source: This checks the well used as a length scale. A well is circular; a box much wider than it is tall means the detector clipped it at an image edge, or merged two wells, or found something that is not a well. Any of those makes :attr:`diameter_px` wrong, and since that diameter rescales every area in the well, a wrong one is worse than a missing one.
records.translation: Esto comprueba el pocillo usado como escala de longitud. Un pocillo es circular; una caja mucho más ancha que alta significa que el detector lo recortó en un borde de la imagen, fusionó dos pocillos o encontró algo que no es un pocillo. Cualquiera de esos casos hace que :attr:`diameter_px` sea incorrecto, y como ese diámetro reescala cada área del pocillo, uno incorrecto es peor que uno ausente.

records.context: The microplate sample position's diameter in pixels, as the mean of the box sides.
records.label: spacr.plaque.Well.diameter_px#0
records.source: The well's diameter in pixels, as the mean of the box sides.
records.translation: El diámetro del pocillo en píxeles, como la media de los lados de la caja.

records.context: A microplate sample position is round, so a correct box is square and the two sides agree. The mean rather than either side alone is what makes a slightly loose box degrade gently instead of biasing one way -- and the disagreement itself is reported by :attr:`axis_ratio`, so a box that is not square is visible rather than silently averaged into a plausible number.
records.label: spacr.plaque.Well.diameter_px#1
records.source: A well is round, so a correct box is square and the two sides agree. The mean rather than either side alone is what makes a slightly loose box degrade gently instead of biasing one way -- and the disagreement itself is reported by :attr:`axis_ratio`, so a box that is not square is visible rather than silently averaged into a plausible number.
records.translation: Un pocillo es redondo, así que una caja correcta es cuadrada y sus dos lados coinciden. Usar la media en lugar de un solo lado es lo que hace que una caja ligeramente holgada se degrade suavemente en lugar de sesgarse hacia un lado -- y la propia discrepancia la informa :attr:`axis_ratio`, de modo que una caja que no es cuadrada queda visible en lugar de promediarse en silencio hasta dar un número plausible.
